parsed.why: Explicit cross-dressing law (Art. 521) plus morality articles, documented arrests, anal exams, police raids, official bans on LGBT assembly; judiciary gives partial relief but enforcement and rising violence against trans people keep this High Risk.

Decriminalised via courts, growing Pride, above-average acceptance, 2024 protections; but immigration act listing 'homosexuals' as prohibited immigrants is a latent traveler-facing entry risk, and religious hostility persists. Reduced Risk.

Criminalising statute is a documented dead letter with no prosecutions and no reported societal violence, plus a recognised third-gender tradition; but no protections, stale data, and no documented relief mechanisms leave Elevated-but-moderate.

No criminalisation, functioning LGR, employment/media protections and rising acceptance; but wartime border stops of male-marker holders, humiliating military-medical gatekeeping, draft Civil Code annulment clause and dated unpunished violence weigh against.

Post-coup organised targeting: trans-specific Police Act detention, police stripping/beating, torture in custody, killings of LGBTIQ people, 377 enforcement intensified, no recognition or recourse. Severe Risk, near the bottom.
